sources.title: AI-KYC Identity Verification System - GitHub
sources.snippet: An AI-powered KYC (Know Your Customer) verification system that automates identity authentication using OCR, Face Recognition, Liveness Detection, Blur Analysis, and AI-driven Risk Scoring. Built with Python, Flask, OpenCV, Tesseract, Deep Learning, and a secure admin dashboard.
